analyst.summary: Bata India's footwear business has been essentially flat on revenue for two years while profit has nearly halved and returns on capital have fallen from 25% to 13% over the past six years, reflecting rising competition from newer footwear brands and higher operating costs. Despite a roughly 30-40% stock price decline, the shares still trade at a rich 54-65 times trailing earnings for a business that is not growing. We recommend continuing to treat this as a Sell.
